answer: Operator-Linked Liability Escrow. Each identity registers under an operator key that owns a shared escrow; a delta in verified abuse reports against any identity raises the escrow premium owed by that operator across all its identities. Operators settle premiums in onyx-denominated credits, and unpaid premiums freeze every identity tied to the operator key. A cipher of the operator key links registrations without exposing them. Cost: one bad identity taxes the whole fleet, so running N identities multiplies exposure by N.
